verdict.pick: GL.iNet GL-X3000 5G Router with SIM Card Slot
verdict.line: Picture a remote worker who needs a versatile home or travel router that can handle multiple WAN connections and strong VPNs. The GL‑iNet GL‑X3000 offers dual‑band Wi‑Fi 6, Multi‑WAN flexibility and robust VPN support, making it the most adaptable choice. The catch: it is larger and may need a wider power adapter.
